nodes.question: What are some of the performance indexes investigated in the third section of the survey related to production in the supply chain?
nodes.answer: Some of the performance indexes investigated in the third section of the survey related to production include energy consumption reduction (PP1), raw material reuse and recycle (PP2), and water consumption tracking (PP3) (Islam et al., 2020).
